hero.title: Decide who sees what on your site
hero.lead: An Access Group links your content to your Membership Levels. Pick what to protect, choose who gets in, and decide what everyone else sees. Protect a whole site, one post or a single block.

tasks.text: Lock all my posts or pages

tasks.sub: Access Groups panel in the editor

tasks.text: Send visitors to my pricing page
Tease the start of an article
Show my plans on a page
Find out why a visitor is blocked

branches.label: How it fits together
branches.goal: Understand which check decides whether someone gets in.

nodes.label: How protection works
nodes.ux: See the checks that decide who gets in.
facts: One group the member holds a level for is enough
Membership must be Active or Trial and not expired
Administrators skip all protection on your site
Comments, feeds and REST responses are protected too

branches.label: Inside an access group
branches.where: Fluent Members › Access Groups › open a group
branches.goal: Set what the group protects and what blocked visitors see.

nodes.label: Restriction types
nodes.ux: Choose what the group protects, one rule at a time.
facts: Core: Entire Website, All Posts, All Pages, All Categories Archive, All Tags Archive, Specific Post/Page/CPT/Taxonomy etc.
Custom taxonomy terms save but protect nothing
A parent category does not cover posts only in a child category
FluentCart Products: needs FluentCart
WooCommerce Products (Pro): needs WooCommerce
Excluded: exceptions for one rule

nodes.label: What blocked visitors see
nodes.ux: Redirect blocked visitors or show them a message.
facts: Actions: Redirect to a specific URL, Display a custom message
Uses your global default until you click Customize for this rule
Revert to defaults removes the group's own settings

nodes.label: Drip content
nodes.ux: Unlock content step by step after a member joins.
facts: Timeline: After duration, Within duration
Delay in Days, Hours and Minutes
Leave Show This Content blank to cover the whole group

branches.label: Inside the editor
branches.goal: Protect one post, or one part of a post, while you write it.

nodes.label: Protect a single post
nodes.ux: Lock one post or page from its own sidebar.
facts: Access Groups panel on the Post or Page tab
Replaces the rules of your groups for that post
Works on any public post type

nodes.label: Access Groups block
nodes.ux: Keep a post public and hide only part of it.
facts: Any block: Access Groups panel on the Block tab
Several blocks: wrap them in the Access Groups block
No group ticked means visible to everyone

nodes.label: Nesting & limits
nodes.ux: Know what happens when restricted blocks sit inside each other.
facts: Every layer must pass
Blocked blocks show fixed text or a partial preview
Exclude Content from Restriction does not apply to blocks

nodes.label: Membership Levels block
nodes.ux: Show your levels and plans on any page.
facts: Levels to display
Plans per row: 1 to 4
Logged-in button and Logged-out button text
Display toggles for title, description and level name

branches.label: Site-wide settings
branches.goal: Show the start of protected content to win visitors over.

nodes.label: Partial content lock
nodes.ux: Show a readable preview, then blur the rest.
facts: Preview Length: 10 to 500 words, 50 by default
Overlay color, opacity and message
Button text, URL, colors and size
Turn it off per post or per block
